interpretation: All stage and CreateContainer rows have additivity=do_not_sum. Nested/cumulative/propagated measurements overlap.
Do not subtract aggregate means or percentiles across populations, processes or clocks to invent an unmeasured stage.
A stage statistic describes observed log records; coverage counts distinct owned IDs. Repeated records are exposed, not silently deduplicated.
Missing values remain null, including genuinely absent stages. Zero is included only when explicitly measured.
A short profile does not by itself establish a bottleneck or performance regression.
warnings: Log rotation/truncation/capture gaps were reported; stage coverage may be incomplete.
Collector reported additional capture gaps; inspect evidence_integrity.capture_gaps.

phase_classification.method: exclusive-template; exact Master request/response pairs; proven serial warmup boundary

evidence.preflight_drain_basis: Pinned suite requires empty API inventory after guest_preflight and again before benchmark; suite preflight/case success verified. Delete ack alone is not proof of drain.

limitations: Server phase classification only; cube-bench raw rows are not mapped to sandbox IDs.
Depends on exclusive use of the dedicated template, the pinned official runner, and complete captured Master logs.
No source ownership file is modified. Failed checks leave all phases unclassified.

interpretation: Values retain native metric units. Gauge changes are endpoint changes, not event counts or latency.
Histogram average is delta(sum)/delta(count); bucket quantiles are interpolated estimates with bounds, not exact sample percentiles.
Includes every observation between scrapes (warmup, formal and unrelated work); no sandbox or benchmark phase attribution is inferred.
Two snapshots cannot detect every restart/reset, prove exclusive workload, or recover missing increments. Invalid series are not reset-corrected.
v0.7.1 CreateContainer restore sub-stages and Cubelet workflow durations are logs, not exported latency histograms.
